findings.title: Logo measurable mark API removed
findings.detail: The prior Logo wrapper supported opt-in `measurable` so only the header lockup got `markMeasure: 'mark'`; the deleted comment documented that marking every instance made `[data-measure="mark"]` resolve to three nodes and hung qa-visual. The new `createLogo({ href, ariaLabel, defaultHeight })` call site has no measurable/markMeasure control. From this diff alone it is impossible to verify the header still has exactly one measured brand mark and that footer/drawer instances stay unmarked. FAIL — cannot verify; regression risk either way (zero marks or three).

findings.title: Header qa-visual markers dropped
findings.detail: Explicit `testId="compact-header"` and `measure="header"` were removed from SharedHeader. A comment claims markers default on the shared Header, but design-system Header is not in this diff, so the default values and that they still match harness selectors are unverified. PASS needs proof; absence of the props here without the default implementation is a FAIL.

findings.title: NavLink export deleted without consumers
findings.detail: The exported `NavLink` component and `NavLinkProps` interface were deleted; only `drawerNavItems` now ends with `withGithubNav(...)`. No other files in the diff update imports of `NavLink` from this module. If anything still imported it, the tree breaks; if nothing did, the change is dead-code cleanup — neither is verified here. FAIL closed.

findings.title: companyLegalColumns behavior unverified
findings.detail: Company/About/Contact and Legal/Terms/Privacy columns were replaced by `...companyLegalColumns({...})`. Labels are passed correctly, but the helper (hrefs `/about`, `/contact`, `/terms`, `/privacy`, column shape, order) lives outside this diff and is not shown. Required legal footer links are not proven present from the dashboard side alone. FAIL — cannot verify.

findings.title: withGithubNav equivalence unverified
findings.detail: Drawer nav previously appended `{ key: 'github', label, to: null, href: GITHUB_URL, external: true }`. Now it relies on design-system `withGithubNav(headerNavItems(), en.app.navGitHub, GITHUB_URL)`. Key, external flag, and `to: null` are not visible in this diff. FAIL — cannot verify parity.

findings.title: PageHeaderProps / PageDrawerProps not in diff
findings.detail: Local prop interfaces were replaced with `PageHeaderProps` and `PageDrawerProps` from design-system/Page. Call sites still use `menuOpen`/`headerRef`/`menuBtnRef`/`onToggleMenu` and `open`/`drawerRef`/`closeBtnRef`/`onClose`, but those type definitions are not in the diff. Contract match is unverified from this change set. FAIL closed.

findings.title: No tests for shell refactor
findings.detail: Diff only touches shell wrappers (Footer, Header, Logo, MobileDrawer, NavLinks, constants). No test, snapshot, or qa-visual fixture updates accompany removal of measurable Logo, header measure/testId props, NavLink export, or footer column helper. New behavior is unasserted. FAIL — change without proof of behavior.

findings.title: DRAWER_LOGO_HEIGHT constant extraction
findings.detail: Replaces magic `48` with named `DRAWER_LOGO_HEIGHT = 48` used by MobileDrawer. Value matches prior prop; no defect found in this hunk.
